problem_statement: NODE_RESULT source_node_id is presently self-describing packet data. The deterministic nodes registry is not included in S1 snapshot identity, runtime_register_node does not create a packet-bound admission identity, and coordinator admission does not prove that the exact logical node/process instance producing a result was an active healthy runtime member. PID overlap and packet hash consistency therefore do not by themselves establish source membership provenance.

reason: Runtime membership is deterministic control-plane authority, not cognitive S1 content, so it should not be silently folded into the S1 cognitive-state digest merely to make a test green.

A global membership-generation-only rule would invalidate unrelated healthy node results whenever any other node joins/leaves. Per-node admission identity gives the required source provenance with less false staleness.
A process PID is runtime evidence, not a replay-stable logical identity. Logical admission and process-instance witness must remain separate but cross-bound.

PROCESS_INSTANCE_WITNESS/v1.purpose: Bind a concrete live OS process instance to an already-authorized logical node admission for bounded runtime evidence.

transition_law: First registration of a logical node creates node_admission_revision=1 and a controller-minted node_admission_id.

Capability change, unregister, health transition that changes result eligibility, generation change, or restart/rejoin that creates a new authorized process instance must create a successor admission revision rather than silently mutate the old authority object.
The superseded admission remains immutable historical provenance but is not current result-source authority.
Rejoin of the same logical_node_id must therefore be distinguishable from continuity of the old process instance.
Unrelated membership changes to other nodes do not automatically stale an otherwise unchanged source node admission.

node_result_binding.law: Packet self-consistency proves only packet integrity. Source authority is established only when deterministic coordinator admission resolves source_node_admission_id in controller-owned membership state, checks the exact revision/generation/capability and current eligibility policy, and cross-binds the process witness where physical-runtime provenance is claimed.

coordinator_admission_checks: logical node id mismatch between packet and admission -> RESULT_SOURCE_NODE_BINDING_INVALID
physical proof claim with absent/mismatched process witness -> RESULT_SOURCE_PROCESS_WITNESS_INVALID
all source-membership checks occur before admitted_results mutation or cohort-derived S1 summary commit

physical_grid10_cohort_extension.requirement: A physical GRID10 cohort manifest must contain ten distinct active source_node_admission_id values and ten distinct valid process-instance witnesses, each bound to the exact packet_digest produced by that process.

counterhypotheses.claim: Trusted harness-controlled --node values and parent-owned Popen calls are enough for a narrow benchmark.
counterhypotheses.decision: Potentially true only for a narrowly named trusted-fixture claim. It is insufficient for general result-flow provenance or reusable EntityOS/HCU runtime semantics.

counterhypotheses.claim: Put the complete nodes table into the existing S1 state_digest and reject any membership change globally.
counterhypotheses.decision: Simpler but over-couples runtime authority to cognitive S1 and can create false staleness from unrelated node changes. Retain as a baseline challenger, not preferred design.

eval_concepts: self-asserted node identity is not membership authority
packet hash integrity is not source authorization
logical node identity differs from process-instance evidence
restart/rejoin creates successor authority rather than narrative continuity
unrelated membership churn must not cause indiscriminate cognitive staleness
historical evidence may remain valid as evidence without becoming current source authority

next_exact_action: Implement the minimum deterministic membership-admission gate and negatives as a successor to current GRID10 v3 source: ghost, unhealthy, stale-rejoin admission and process-witness transplant must fail before cohort integration. Re-enter current main first and deduplicate against parallel fixes. Do not create a provider lane or runtime promotion request while current proof/authentication gates remain unresolved.
